title: PhD in Interdisciplinary Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
institution: EPSRC CDT in Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (NanoDTC), University of Cambridge
about: Cambridge's NanoDTC has opened applications for its October 2027 interdisciplinary MRes+PhD in nanoscience and nanotechnology. The first internal review deadline is 8 December 2026, with a second deadline on 2 January 2027.
requirements: Submit by 2 January 2027 to be considered for full University-based funding (NanoDTC page)
card_alt: Card for the PhD in Interdisciplinary Nanoscience and Nanotechnology at EPSRC CDT in Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (NanoDTC), University of Cambridge, in Cambridge, United Kingdom, with a first application deadline of 8 Dec 2026.
